skill.name: Ice Shard
skill.description: Throws a spear of ice that shatters when it hits an enemy, dealing magic damage and slowing Move Speed. Shards pass through the target, dealing the same damage to other enemies hit.

skill.name: Emberstrike
skill.description: Shyvana's next attack strikes both the target and the surrounding area. This Ability can be recast. While in Dragon Form, it gains an additional recast, dealing massive damage to a single target.

skill.name: Inferno Aegis
skill.description: Shyvana gains a shield, movement speed, and after a short delay, the area around her detonates.  While in Dragon Form, the explosion will heal her if it strikes an enemy champion.

skill.name: Molten Burst
skill.description: Shyvana launches a fireball that explodes upon striking a large target and slows them. In Dragon Form, it passes through and explodes upon striking large enemies, leaving behind a trail of fire.

passive.name: Scalemail
passive.description: Takedowns on enemy champions, large minions, and large monsters grant Shyvana Scalemail stacks, improving her defenses.

skill.name: Dragon's Descent
skill.description: Shyvana transforms into a Dragon and leaps forward causing enemies along her path to flee. While in Dragon form she becomes larger and her basic abilities are empowered.

skill.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
skill.description: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.

skill.name: Orb of Deception
skill.description: Ahri sends out and pulls back her orb, dealing magic damage on the way out and true damage on the way back.

skill.name: Conquering Sands
skill.description: Azir sends all Sand Soldiers towards a location. Sand Soldiers deal magic damage to enemies they pass through and apply a slow for 1 second.

skill.name: Arise!
skill.description: Azir summons a Sand Soldier to attack nearby targets for him, replacing his basic attack against targets within the soldier's range. Their attacks deal magic damage to enemies in a line.

skill.name: Twin Fang
skill.description: Cassiopeia lets loose an attack that deals increased damage to Poisoned targets and heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt. If the target dies from this attack, Cassiopeia regains Mana.

skill.name: Undertow
skill.description: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.

skill.name: Tough It Out
skill.description: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.

skill.name: Reckless Swing
skill.description: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself, refunding the Health cost if he destroys the target.

skill.name: Twilight Assault
skill.description: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.

skill.name: Dreaded Return
skill.description: Zaahen stabs in a direction, damaging enemies hit, then pulls them toward him.

skill.name: Aureate Rush
skill.description: Zaahen dashes to a location and slices around himself.
